messages:
alex: heads-up — we're seeing a sustained burst of 504s from hosted inference for tenant clearpath since ~11:02 UTC. p95 spiked to ~18s and gateway is returning 502/504. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/shot/abc123

sara: thanks — is this auth/billing or pure queue/backpressure? any tenant config changes?

alex: not auth (no 401s). looks like request queue is at capacity: request_queue_depth=1024/1024 on gateway nodes, continuous-batcher backlog growing. logs show long sequences and repeated large-batch flushes. sample gateway log: \"2026-03-18T11:03:05Z ERROR gateway request timed out id=... code=504 queue_depth=1024\"

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-7754321999. runbook: https://confluence/redwood/queue-tailtimeout-runbook

mike: digging in — i can repro a high-payload long-seq that triggers continuous-batching to build giant batches. the runtime then blocks on KV cache spin-up and latency cascades. quick repro: 
```
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $CUSTOMER_KEY\" -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{\"input\":\"<very long document>\"}'
```

lina: is this isolated to clearpath or multi-tenant?

alex: mostly clearpath but we've seen some collateral p95 increases for bursty tenants on the same pool. looks like one tenant's workload filled the queue headroom.

sara: escalation for support — customer complaining about 5xxs. we should give an ETA and mitigation steps.

support-bot: notifying account team and sending automated message to customer: \"We're investigating elevated timeouts on hosted inference; temporary mitigation in progress.\"

mike: short-term mitigations i recommend: reduce max_queue_depth, lower continuous-batcher max_batch_size, enable immediate fallback to low-memory model. patch suggestion (routing config):
```
routing:
  fallback_model: rdx-small-v1
  max_queue_depth: 512
  batch_timeout_ms: 20
```

lina: i'll push a conservative rollout to half the pool to reduce batch_timeout_ms from 50 -> 20 and set max_queue_depth to 600. rolling now on pool-hosted-1.

ops-bot: deploy started by lina at 2026-03-18T11:10:12Z. CI job: https://ci.redwood/job/rollout-7754321999

alex: deployed to 50% nodes. observing queue depth drop to ~620 and p95 improving to 4.2s. still seeing intermittent 502s but much lower.

sara: good. mike, can you add a short-term autoscaler tweak to detect long-seq flood and apply tenant throttling? we need to avoid single tenant saturating shared pool.

mike: noted — creating PR to add tenant-request-rate limiter and a short backoff policy for sequences > 10k tokens. PR: https://git.redwood/pr/9922

lina: finished rolling to 100% with conservative settings. p95 now ~1.1s, 504s down to baseline.

alex: closing incident? any postmortem items?

sara: yes — actions: (1) implement tenant-level seq throttling (mike), (2) add alert on continuous-batcher backlog ratio > 0.7 (lina), (3) customer follow-up w/ RCA and workaround details (support).

support-bot: customer notified that a mitigation was applied and that we'll follow up with RCA.

mike: PR opened, unit tests added. timeline for full fix: 48h for rollout + monitoring tuning.

ops-bot: incident resolved: INC-2026-7754321999 at 2026-03-18T11:33:54Z — reduced 5xx from 12/min -> 0.4/min.

alex: thanks all, closing thread. :thumbsup:
